sourceContract.absent: authorized actives / inactives / depth chart / coach playing-time statements
sourceContract.whatAbsenceMeans: without that source, CONFIRMED_OUT, EXPECTED_STARTER, EXPECTED_ROTATION, LIMITED are all UNREACHABLE. Every named player stays AVAILABLE_ROLE_UNCERTAIN.
sourceContract.basisWarning: shares are MEASURED preseason shares by depth rank, from 292 preseason team-games. Regular-season usage is used only to ORDER players by depth and never to set a magnitude — carrying a regular-season share through unchanged would hand a projection a full-game workload and call it evidence, and scaling it by an invented factor (Program 182) was wrong by more than a factor of four in the other direction.
